name: hugo-quality-ci
description: Pull-request quality gates for Hugo sites: front matter, content accuracy, links, accessibility and structured data.
author: Joe Petrucelli <joepetjr@gmail.com>

comments.dependencies: None, deliberately. Every script here is Node stdlib only, so it can be copied straight into a site without changing that site's dependency tree. pa11y-ci and Lighthouse CI are invoked via npx from the workflow and are not dependencies of this package.
